message:
If someone in your family is getting the keys to a new flat this year, this is worth ten minutes on handover day.

Under the RERA Act 2016, a buyer has 5 years from the day of possession to report defects, and the builder has to fix them free of charge within 30 days (Section 14(3)). That only helps if you notice and record the problems. Ask for the occupancy certificate, measure the rooms against the carpet area in your agreement, run every tap, look for damp, test every switch, and send the builder a dated snag list with photos. Then ask when the conveyance deed will be registered.

Did you find anything wrong when you took possession of your home?

Source: RERA Act 2016, Sec 2(k), 11(4)(b), 14(3), 17(1), 19(10). State rules can differ. AI-generated imagery. Educational content, not advice.
